name: JG_FSCL_DOC_GROUPS
description: This table defines the Fiscal Document types that will be generated for a transaction that requires multiple Fiscal Documents.

columns.name: TRX_FD_TYPE_DETERMINANT
columns.description: Fiscal document type determinant, which indicates whether single or multiple fiscal documents are required for a transaction.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code for which the fiscal document type is defined.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Fiscal document type associated with the fiscal document group.

columns.name: GENERATION_SEQUENCE
columns.description: Generation sequence for multiple fiscal documents.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_APPROVAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the document is treated as an approval for the overall transaction. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: TAX_INVOICE_NUMBER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the fiscal document number is treated as the tax invoice number.

columns.name: TAX_INCLUSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether taxes will be included for a fiscal document type.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_REF_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether the reference document is an external document.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
